title: A survey on rigorous results for the dynamics of periodic FPU chains
summary: In this paper we review some analytic results on the dynamics of the FPU system. In the first part of the paper, having in mind that the FPU Hamiltonian and the Toda Hamiltonian are close each other, we present some results on the action angle variables of the Toda system and deduce some stability properties for the dynamics of the FPU system. We first focus on the case of finitely many particles and then we study the limit $N\to\infty$.
